title: Japanese
description: Polite everyday Japanese with romaji: greetings, family, food, numbers, travel and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
tips: Japanese uses three scripts: hiragana (ありがとう), katakana for foreign words (コーヒー) and kanji (元気). 'です' (desu) and 'ます' (masu) make sentences polite.

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
tips: When talking about your own family use 母 (haha, mother) and 父 (chichi, father); お母さん and お父さん are used for someone else's.

units.title: Food and drink
tips: Particles follow the word they mark: を (o) marks the object, が (ga) the subject: コーヒーを飲みます = (I) drink coffee.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
tips: Japanese counts things with counters: 二人 (futari) for two people, 四つ (yottsu) for four things, 三時 (sanji) for three o'clock.

units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.

tips: 'これ を ください' (kore o kudasai, this one please) works in any shop.
